==Summary==

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

[[Rand]] and [[Loial]] talk about the information Loial wants for his book on the Dragon Reborn. [[Nynaeve]], [[Min Farshaw|Min]], [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin|Cadsuane]] and [[Alivia]] are present along with two of the fifty Aiel Maidens that arrived. 

When Loial mentions [[Mat Cauthon|Mat]] and [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]], Rand experiences visions of them. Mat is riding through a forest with mounted men following. Perrin is in a tavern talking with a man and woman dressed oddly. He also gets a vision of the man who saved his life in [[Shadar Logoth]] when he fought [[Sammael]]. However, he doesn't know who the man is.

[[Logain]] returns and reports half the [[Asha'man]], including all of those bonded to [[Aes Sedai]], are now in [[Arad Doman]] and [[Illian]] now. Arad Doman is in chaos with no one really in charge but [[Rhuarc]] is putting things in order. He then gives warnings about [[Mazrim Taim]], his special Asha'man and students, and the internal factions within in [[The Black Tower]]. Logain suspects that Taim is a [[Darkfriend]] but Rand is not convinced. [[Verin Mathwin|Verin]] confirms that events clearly indicate [[Last Battle|Tarmon Gai'don]] is approaching. Rand is still planning to make a truce with the [[Seanchan]] despite opposition from others in his party.

Loial is surprised by a visit from his mother, [[Elder Haman]] and [[Erith]], his wife-to-be. He worries that Erith will have him return to [[Stedding Tsofu]] and he won't be able to finish his book. Rand is warned by [[Nynaeve]] that a terrible storm is coming. He wonders if this refers to Tarmon Gai'don or something else.
